main.description: A user-submitted video associated with a movie, TV show, season, or episode.

videoUrl.description: Canonical YouTube URL for the submitted video.

videoTitle.description: Title returned by YouTube when the video was submitted.

channelName.description: Name of the YouTube channel when the video was submitted.

channelUrl.description: URL of the YouTube channel when the video was submitted.

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail URL returned by YouTube when the video was submitted.

youtubeId.description: YouTube video ID parsed from videoUrl.

videoType.description: The kind of video being submitted.

creativeWorkType.description: The specificity of the creative work associated with this video.

title.description: Title of the associated movie, show, season, or episode.

containsSpoilers.description: Whether the video may contain spoilers.

tmdbId.description: TMDB ID of the exact movie, show, season, or episode.

tmdbTvSeriesId.description: TMDB ID of the containing TV series.

seasonNumber.description: Season number when targeting a season or episode.

episodeNumber.description: Episode number when targeting an episode.
